A '''joy cave''' was a type of underground pleasure chamber on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|175|joy cave}}</ref>

One such cave was the [[Kala'uun joy cave]].<ref name="Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref>
